global_issues.title: Strong Jobs Data Lifts Sept Fed Hike Odds, Yields Test 4.8%
global_issues.note: Confirmed: August jobs report (162k added, unemployment 4.1%) pushed CME FedWatch Sept-hike odds to ~58-65%, and 10-year yield hit 4.79%, effectively testing 4.8%. No material change overnight — US markets were closed Sept 7 for Labor Day, so this remains the live narrative into the Sept 8 open.

global_issues.title: Middle East Oil Supply Risks Drive WTI to Six-Week Highs
global_issues.note: Confirmed by multiple sources (BNN Bloomberg, FXStreet, Reuters). Escalated further over the weekend: Iran reportedly targeted tankers using an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz plus US-linked vessels in retaliation for US strikes, keeping WTI elevated near six-week/three-month highs. Briefing's framing is accurate but slightly understates the weekend escalation severity.
